Aisha (oncall): RCA is live: https://redwood.internal/rca/2876540123 — short summary + actions below. Please skim and ack. :eyes:
Clara (prod): TL;DR for skimmers: cache shard corruption after a config rollout caused stale model weights to be served for a subset of requests, increasing error rates and token drift for ~32m. Customer-visible errors started at 2026-04-14 14:08 UTC.
Ben (infra): Root cause in the doc is the cache shard restart ordering + a config flag that allowed old entries to bypass validation. Full timeline in section 1.2.
Aisha (oncall): Quick highlights copy-pasted for visibility:
```
Impact: degraded responses (higher perplexity, embeddings drift) for ~32 minutes affecting ~8% of hosted API traffic in europe-west region.
Root cause: cache shard restart ordering + validation bypass flag in rollout v2-config-9.
Mitigation: rolled back config and performed targeted cache flushes at 14:40 UTC.
Customer notice: drafted and queued for release (ops review required).
```
Diego (eng-sre): Action items (owner, due):
- Ben: blocklist the validation-bypass flag and add preflight check by 2026-04-16 EOD.
- Aisha: add an incident replay test to CI that simulates cache shard restarts by 2026-04-20.
- Clara: finalize customer communication and publish external post by 2026-04-15 12:00 PT.
- Diego: add monitoring alert for cache-entry-staleness and a dashboard panel by 2026-04-18.
- Ellen: approve prioritization for a config rollout safety gate in next sprint planning (owner: Ellen) by 2026-04-16.
NotifierBot: Draft notice queued — review needed: https://redwood.internal/drafts/rca-2876540123
Clara (prod): Office hours to triage actions + sign off on external note: 2026-04-15 16:00 PT (link: https://calendar.internal/redwood/event/rca-2876540123-review)
Ben (infra): I've started the preflight check PR, will tag Diego for review. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/preflight/234
Aisha (oncall): Mitigation details we ran in prod: `config.rollback(v2-config-8)`, `cache.flush(shard=7, region=europe-west)`. Deploys standard.
Diego (eng-sre): I'll own the canary verification for the safety gate changes — ETA 2026-04-19 10:00 PT.
Ellen (cto): Thanks team. Please ensure the customer note includes the technical root cause and the concrete steps we're taking to avoid recurrence. Also ensure the postmortem links to the CI replay tests once live.
Clara (prod): Ack. I'll paste the customer note here for quick review by 2026-04-15 09:00 PT.
